title: Cinderline: keeping one save format across browser, Windows and Linux with an AI-assisted workflow
author: KlutzyInteraction650
selftext:
I'm Ahmed, the solo developer behind Cinderline Studio / ANKH ENTERPRISE LTD. I recently released Cinderline, a commercial 2D fantasy tower-defense game, and wanted to share a concrete part of the AI-assisted development process rather than just a trailer.

The browser game and packaged Windows/Linux editions keep the same whole-profile save format. Players can export/import a JSON backup, with cloud saving as an explicit optional choice. The useful checks were at the boundaries: earn progress, restart the packaged app, compare the saved profile, transfer it between editions, and make sure a failed cloud request keeps the local progress. Automated checks and packaged runs helped catch those cases; that is not a claim that an independent human completed the whole campaign or that every physical device was tested.

For the visuals, OpenAI image generation produced much of the character, enemy, tower and environment artwork, which was prepared and animated with scripts; some pieces were rendered in Blender. AI assistants also contributed code, scripts and copy under my direction, and audio is synthesized in code. The artwork ships as packaged assets; players do not need a generative-AI account. Keeping an existing approved art set and save schema stable while adding platform adapters was more useful than repeatedly regenerating everything.

One practical takeaway was to treat the local JSON backup as a separate recovery route: a cloud transport failure must not overwrite the player's good local profile. I'd be interested in the concrete save/recovery failure cases other developers test across browser and desktop releases.

Commercial disclosure: this is my own paid game, regular US $4.99 for full browser access and Windows/Linux downloads. The current price, real gameplay captures, tested-system notes and full AI disclosure are on its itch page: https://cinderline-studio.itch.io/cinderline-desktop
